description: This file contains functions and types related to resolving and filtering reply modes in a chat application, including handling threading and channel-specific configurations.

methods.name: normalizeReplyToModeChatType
methods.description: Normalizes chat type string to specific reply mode string or undefined.

methods.name: resolveReplyToModeChannelKey
methods.description: Resolves a channel identifier to a normalized key string.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredReplyToMode
methods.description: Determines the reply mode based on configuration, channel, and chat type.

methods.name: resolveReplyToModeWithThreading
methods.description: Resolves reply mode considering threading adapter and configuration.

methods.name: resolveReplyToMode
methods.description: Resolves reply mode based on channel, account, and chat type, using threading if available.

methods.name: createReplyToModeFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter function for reply payloads based on reply mode and options.

methods.name: createReplyToModeFilterForChannel
methods.description: Creates a reply mode filter specific to a channel, considering threading and channel type.
